data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (choose city, open Special Events, pick an event, select ticket count, Book Now, then Reserve), but it leaves out the date parameter and the final Reserve Now click, and it adds an unneeded "Review dialog" step. The "scroll and See More" step is vague, so an automation would need guesses to fill the gaps.
